description: This file defines a generic serializer class 'RepeatedFieldCodec<T>' for serializing and deserializing 'RepeatedField<T>' objects using Orleans serialization framework and Google Protobuf collections. It includes methods for writing and reading repeated fields, handling references, and managing wire protocol details.

classes.name: RepeatedFieldCodec<T>
classes.description: A serializer class for handling serialization and deserialization of 'RepeatedField<T>' objects within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a 'RepeatedField<T>'' to the writer, handling references and writing each element using the provided field codec.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a 'RepeatedField<T>'' from the reader, handling references, reading length, and individual elements.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Throws an exception if the declared size exceeds the input length.

methods.name: ThrowLengthFieldMissing
methods.description: Throws an exception if the length field is missing during deserialization.
